allowClear.zh-CN: 是否允许再次点击后清除。
allowClear.en-US: Whether clicking the selected star again clears the value.

allowHalf.en-US: Whether half stars can be selected.

character.zh-CN: 每颗星中绘制的字符，字符串或 snippet；字符串同时是各星可访问名称与整组摘要的单位，snippet 则用语言包的单位。
character.en-US: Character drawn in every star, a string or a snippet. A string is also the unit in each star's accessible name and the group summary; for a snippet the locale's unit is used.

disabled.zh-CN: 只读，无法进行交互，也无法获得焦点。
disabled.en-US: Read-only: no interaction and no focus.

onBlur.zh-CN: 焦点离开整个评分组件时的回调。
onBlur.en-US: Called when focus leaves the rating.

onChange.zh-CN: 选择变化时的回调，参数为新的值。
onChange.en-US: Called when the selection changes, with the new value.

onClick.zh-CN: 点击星或按 Enter、Space 选中时的回调，参数为事件与星的序号；会遮住根元素上的原生 click 监听。
onClick.en-US: Called when a star is clicked or selected with Enter or Space, with the event and the star index. It shadows a native click listener on the root element.

onFocus.zh-CN: 焦点进入整个评分组件时的回调，在星之间移动不触发。
onFocus.en-US: Called when focus enters the rating; moving between stars does not call it.

onHoverChange.zh-CN: 指针经过时数值变化的回调；指针移出或点击清除时收到 undefined。
onHoverChange.en-US: Called when the hovered value changes; receives undefined when the pointer leaves or a click clears the value.

onKeyDown.zh-CN: 仅在方向键使值移动时的回调。
onKeyDown.en-US: Called only for an arrow key that moved the value.

prefixCls.en-US: Class name prefix of the component.

preventScroll.zh-CN: 指示浏览器是否应滚动文档以显示新聚焦的元素，作用于组件内的聚焦。
preventScroll.en-US: Whether the browser should avoid scrolling the document to show the newly focused element, for focus inside the component.

size.zh-CN: 尺寸，可选 default、small，也可传入 number 自定义尺寸。
size.en-US: Size: default or small, or a number for a custom size.

value.zh-CN: 当前值，可用 `bind:value` 双向绑定。`bind:value={get, set}` 时完全受控；只传 `value` 时作为初值，之后由用户操作改变。
value.en-US: Current value; bind it with `bind:value`. `bind:value={get, set}` makes it fully controlled; a plain `value` is the initial value and user interaction changes it afterwards.

focus.zh-CN: 聚焦 Tab 会到达的 radio，与 autofocus 的落点相同；disabled 时无效果。
focus.en-US: Focuses the radio that Tab reaches, the same one autofocus uses. Does nothing when disabled.

blur.zh-CN: 让评分内获得焦点的元素失焦；焦点不在评分内或 disabled 时无效果。
blur.en-US: Blurs the focused element inside the rating. Does nothing when focus is elsewhere or the rating is disabled.
